Specification: This module is a small test specification for TLA+ operator arguments. It checks that user-defined operators and built-in infix operators can be passed as arguments to higher-order operators, using helper definitions like FooBar and Foo and validating the results through TLC's Print and Assert operators. The state space itself is trivial, with a single variable x, an initialization x = 1, a stuttering Next action x' = x, and a state predicate Inv that contains several IF-THEN-ELSE checks for expected arithmetic results.
IfThenElse: IF FooBar(7, Plus) = 7 THEN Print("Test 1 OK", TRUE) ELSE Assert(FALSE, "Test 1 Failed")
IF FooBar(7,+) = 7 THEN Print("Test 2 OK", TRUE) ELSE Assert(FALSE, "Test 2 Failed")
IF Foo(7, *) = 0 THEN Print("Test 3 OK", TRUE) ELSE Assert(FALSE, "Test 3 Failed")
IF Foo(7,+) = 7 THEN Print("Test 4 OK", TRUE) ELSE Assert(FALSE, "Test 4 Failed")
IF Foo(7,++) = 7 THEN Print("Test 5 OK", TRUE) ELSE Assert(FALSE, "Test 5 Failed")
